card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The blank space (or 'to') right before a dose number such as 80 mg, 160 mg or 20 to 120 mg. It appears in dosing tables and schedules, where the next word is a number.

modes.label: Space before next dose
modes.description: A space after 'and', 'orally' or 'to increase to' where a new dose figure follows.
modes.example: Aprepitant capsules in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older: is 125 mg on Day 1 and<< >>80 mg on Days 2 and

modes.label: Space before dose range
modes.description: A space after a drug or population name in a table, just before a dose or dose range.

modes.label: 'to' in a range
modes.description: The word 'to' inside a numeric dose range.
modes.example: Schizophrenia-Adults ( 2.2 ) 25 mg twice daily 150<< to>> 750 mg/day 7

card.writes: It seems to steer away from words like regimen or course and toward a number coming next.
card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a dose amount in dosing tables and schedules.
